caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp nori, and shredded scallions. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a black tray against a warm, softly lit background.

segments_info.text: Black tray with textured surface, rectangular shape, slightly raised edges, visible grain pattern.
The chashu pork is golden-brown, tender-looking, and slightly curled, with a seared surface and visible fat marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slightly curled edges.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles, green onions, and a dark green seaweed sheet.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A white ceramic spoon with a smooth, slightly curved surface and a small yellow stain near its tip.
